item.text:
Refactored the app back toward a simpler domain model by removing the redundant graph-conversion layer.

[AdjacencyMatrix.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/026_prims_mst/AdjacencyMatrix.java:5) now implements `Graph` directly, so the extra `GraphFactory`/`NeighborListGraphFactory` and `NeighborListGraph` types are gone. [MstApplication.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/026_prims_mst/MstApplication.java:1) is simpler again, depending only on a single [GraphSource.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/026_prims_mst/GraphSource.java:1), the MST algorithm, and the formatter. The sample data loader is now just [SampleGraphSource.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/026_prims_mst/SampleGraphSource.java:1), and [MST.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/026_prims_mst/MST.java:5) only wires those three pieces together.

This is a real simplification rather than more layering: the matrix already satisfied the `Graph` contract, so the conversion types were unnecessary indirection.

Verified with `javac -d build/classes *.java` and `java -cp build/classes MST`; output is unchanged.
